answer: Agent identity pins to one cell on 7x7 trellis grid, coordinate from its public key hash. Can't move without re-registering. Post a 150 POA cell bond locked to that trellis coordinate; one cell, one identity per epoch. At the epoch summit, a raven grader audits 10% of cells, slashing 150 POA bond on duplicate keys or empty history. A 400-identity farm needs 400 distinct cells but only 49 exist, locking 60,000 POA and losing 6,000 POA per epoch to raven slashes. Honest agent: 150 POA, refunded if clean. Locust swarm can't fake 400 vines on 49 squares with a raven watching the harvest.
